articles.title: Azure Logic Apps Adds Sandboxed Code Interpreters to Agent Workflows
articles.reason: Sandboxed code interpreters in Azure Logic Apps enable secure, customizable agent workflows directly relevant to building enterprise-grade, compliant agentic pipelines for finance and insurance clients.
articles.summary: Azure Logic Apps now supports sandboxed code interpreters, allowing agents to generate and execute Python, JavaScript, C#, and PowerShell in isolated environments. This gives architects granular control over model selection and execution security per workflow, making Logic Apps a viable platform for agentic integration alongside tools like Foundry and Copilot Studio. The feature is highly relevant for designing secure, compliant, and flexible agent workflows in regulated industries.
